description: Prometheus-compatible metrics exporter. FastAPI port 8789 GET /metrics returns text/plain prometheus format. Metrics: zo_sentinel_servers_total{verdict} gauge, zo_sentinel_trust_score_avg gauge, zo_sentinel_threats_total{severity} counter, zo_sentinel_assessments_24h counter, zo_sentinel_pipeline_health{check} gauge (1=ok 0=degraded), zo_sentinel_api_latency_ms{service} gauge. Updates every 60s via background task. GET /health. Daemon uvicorn port 8789. Heartbeat.
